For **Publications**, please visit my [Publications page](publications.qmd).

```{python}
import yaml
import os
from IPython.display import display, Markdown, HTML

with open("./portfolio/portfolio.yaml") as f:
    items = yaml.safe_load(f)

sorted_items = sorted(items, key=lambda x: (x['dates'][0]['year'], x['dates'][0]['month'], x['title']), reverse=True)
filtered_items = [item for item in sorted_items if 'Research' in item['category']]

contents = "<div class='portfolio'>"
for item in filtered_items:
    # Get the root url of this item
    root_url = os.path.join('.', 'portfolio', item['id'])
    thumb_url = os.path.join(root_url, 'thumbnail.png')
    contents += "<div class='portfolio_item'>"
    contents += "<div class='portfolio_item_contents'>"
    contents += f"<div class='portfolio_item_thumbnail'><img src='{thumb_url}' /></div>"
    contents += f"<h3>{item['title']}</h3>"
    contents += f"<p>Click to read more</p>"
    contents += "</div>"
    contents += "</div>"
contents += "</div>"
display(HTML(contents))
```
